title: Set up and commit the portfolio
prompt: Fill in the blanks so that every new repository starts on `main`, the `portfolio` folder becomes a repository, and the home page is committed with the message on the command line (no editor).
hints: The default branch name is a setting in the `init` group of the configuration.
The command that creates the `.git` folder has the same name as that setting group.
The flag that passes the commit message inline is a single letter, short for message.
explanation: `git config --global init.defaultBranch main` makes `git init` name its first branch `main`. `git init` creates the `.git` folder that holds the repository. `git commit -m "Add home page"` records the staged snapshot with the message inline; leave out `-m` and Git opens `core.editor` to ask for one.
